title: Alpha One — event account.activated v1
description: V1 catalog event `account.activated` (v1). Envelope per EVT-03 (see envelope.schema.json). Producer/consumers per contracts/events/catalog.md: consumers = BRG (start sync), EVL (start evaluation + create evaluation_state), NOT-01, AUD. Derived from: docs/07 §3.1/§5 (CREATED→ACTIVE = the activated state; 'Credentials: issued at account.activated'); docs/32 `accounts.broker_account_id` + `broker_accounts.server`. Money is integer minor units (docs/00 #3); the envelope carries tenant_id — no redundant tenant field in the payload.
